situation: Trying to plan a reunion dinner for 8 college friends in our group chat. Every time someone asks 'when works for everyone' it dies. I want to actually get it booked: Pho Saigon, Friday 23 October, 7:30.
reply: Okay, making this real: dinner at Pho Saigon on Friday 23 October, 7:30. 👍 if you're in, 👎 if you can't, by Sunday night please so I can book. I'll book for everyone who's said yes by then.
note: Propose one plan, ask for a one-tap reply, set a deadline and say what happens by default.

situation: 我们家族群要定今年春节去谁家过，已经讨论了三天，大姑家和二舅家两边都有人支持，吵来吵去定不下来。我是小辈，想推动一下。
reply: 各位长辈，我来汇总一下：目前是两个选项，大姑家或者二舅家。大家在自己支持的那个后面回个1或者2就行，周五晚上8点前统计，按多数定。定下来以后具体安排我再单独跟那边对接。
note: 两个选项、一键回复、截止时间和默认规则。小辈只做汇总和推进，不替长辈拍板。

situation: I booked and paid for the lake house for our friend group's weekend (the 17th to 19th) after the deadline passed, and we're also planning a ski trip in January. Now Chris is complaining in the chat that he wanted the 24th and nobody asked him properly.
reply: Fair, Chris, the 24th would have been easier for you and I'm sorry it didn't work out. It's booked and paid now, so the 17th stands. You get first pick on the dates for the ski trip in January.
note: Acknowledge, hold the decision, hand him the next one. Don't reopen it in the group.

situation: Organicé el regalo de jubilación de Carmen en el grupo de WhatsApp de la oficina: 15 euros cada uno, somos 12. Ya compré la bici de paseo (180 euros) y todavía faltan 4 por pagar, por transferencia o en mano en mi mesa. La fiesta es el viernes 9 de octubre.
reply: ¡La bici de Carmen ya está comprada y bien escondida! 🚲 Gracias a los que ya habéis pagado. Faltan 4 aportaciones de 15 euros: por transferencia o en mano en mi mesa. Si podéis antes del miércoles 7, cierro las cuentas antes de la fiesta del viernes. Pulgar arriba cuando esté hecho y os tacho de la lista.
note: Cobrar en el grupo sin señalar a nadie: importe, cómo pagar, fecha límite y una reacción de un toque. A quien siga sin pagar el miércoles, mensaje privado.

situation: I run a monthly board game night with 6 friends. Ollie has said yes and then bailed on the day for the last three. It's messing up the numbers for 4-player games. I want to message him privately, not call him out in the group. The next one is Friday 23 October.
reply: Hey Ollie, not a big deal, but you've dropped out on the day for the last three game nights and I've started planning the tables around you not coming. If things are hard right now, tell me and I'll stop pestering. If game night just isn't your thing at the moment, that's fine too, I'd rather know. Want me to count you in for Friday 23 October, or sit this one out?
note: A pattern with one person goes to a private message with a real out, never a callout in the group.

situation: I'm in a WhatsApp group with 5 other parents (Anna, Raj, Kemi, Luis and Dana) for the soccer practice carpool, Tuesdays and Thursdays at 5:30. Every week it's chaos over who drives. I want to lock in a rota for October.
reply: Proposal so we stop sorting it week by week. October drivers: Tue 6 Anna, Thu 8 me, Tue 13 Raj, Thu 15 Kemi, Tue 20 Luis, Thu 22 Dana, then Tue 27 Anna and Thu 29 me. Thumbs up if your date works, or reply with a swap by Thursday evening. If nobody objects by then, this is the rota, and any later swaps happen directly between the two drivers.
note: Post a complete draft instead of asking who can drive; the default kicks in if people stay quiet. With children in the cars, a driver who can't make it says so in the group straight away so no child is left waiting, and in an emergency call emergency services first, then the parents.

situation: Sou síndica de um prédio pequeno, 12 apartamentos, com grupo de WhatsApp dos moradores. Preciso marcar a dedetização das áreas comuns e dos apartamentos, e toda vez que pergunto a data ninguém responde. A empresa pode nos sábados 17 ou 24 de outubro, das 8h às 12h.
reply: Oi, pessoal! Vamos marcar a dedetização do prédio. Duas opções: sábado, 17 de outubro, ou sábado, 24 de outubro, sempre das 8h às 12h. Respondam 1 ou 2 até quinta-feira, dia 8. Se ninguém se manifestar, fica o dia 17 e eu confirmo com a empresa na sexta. Quem não puder abrir o apartamento no dia, me chama no privado que a gente combina a chave.
note: Two options, a one-tap reply, a deadline and a default; individual logistics go to a private message, not the group.

situation: Organising a ski trip for 8 of us in our WhatsApp group. Found a chalet in Morzine, Jan 23 to 30, £3,360 total, so £420 each. The owner needs a £1,000 deposit by Monday Oct 12, and everyone keeps replying 'sounds fun!' without actually committing.
reply: Ski trip, real proposal: the chalet in Morzine, Saturday 23 to Saturday 30 January, £420 each for the house. The owner needs a £1,000 deposit by Monday 12 October. If you're in, send me £125 by Friday 9 October and 👍 this message once you have. I'll book with whoever's paid by then, and if we're short I'll offer the spare beds to the wider group.
note: 'Sounds fun' isn't a yes: turn commitment into a small payment with a deadline and a stated default.

situation: 高中同学群30个人，我组织10月10号周六的聚餐，说好昨晚（周一）十点前接龙，结果只有14个人接了，其他人一直没动静。截止后我已按人数订了福满楼二楼两桌，晚上6点半，费用AA。要不要再催一遍？
reply: 接龙截止了，一共14位。我已经订好：10月10日周六晚上6点半，福满楼二楼，两桌，费用AA，当天现场结。没接上但想来的，10月7日周三前私聊我，我去跟饭店加位。群里就不再刷屏了，具体安排到时候拉个小群说。
note: 截止后照说好的办，结果只在群里发一次，不重新问一遍；想来的人给一个私聊补报的窗口。

situation: I'm maid of honour organising Chloe's hen weekend in a WhatsApp group of 9. Two bridesmaids, Amy and Jess, have started arguing in the chat about whether £250 each is too much. Everyone else has gone silent. For the weekend of 7 November I've priced a Bath spa weekend at £250 each and a cottage near Bristol with a cooked dinner at £160 each.
reply: Let's take the budget back-and-forth out of here; I'll pick it up one to one. For everyone: two options for the weekend of 7 November. A: Bath spa weekend, £250 each. B: a cottage near Bristol with a cooked dinner, £160 each. Thumbs on A or B by Friday night and I'll book whichever wins on Saturday morning.
note: Pull the argument out of the group without naming who was arguing, then turn it into two priced options with a deadline; talk to Amy and Jess one at a time.

situation: 我在一个跨时区项目群里，成员分别在北京、柏林和旧金山，一共7个人。周会时间讨论了一周还没定，每次都有人说“我都行”。想把时间定下来。
reply: 各位，周会时间我来提两个选项：A 每周二北京时间晚上10点（柏林下午4点，旧金山早上7点）；B 每周四北京时间晚上11点（柏林下午5点，旧金山早上8点）。都避开了三地的半夜，北京这边会晚一点。请在周三中午（北京时间）前回A或B，按多数定；没人回的话就定A，下周二开始，会议邀请我来发。
note: 跨时区时把每个时区的时间都写出来，别让大家自己换算；截止时间也注明时区。

situation: Our neighbour Ruth, 78, comes home from hip surgery on Monday Oct 5. Her daughter says dinners would help most for the first two weeks and has left a cool box by the front door. I want to set up a rota in our street's WhatsApp group of 14 households without swamping Ruth with visitors.
reply: Ruth is home from her hip operation on Monday 5 October, and her daughter says dinners would help most for the first two weeks. Proposal: one household drops off a dinner each weeknight, 5 to 6pm, in the cool box by her front door so she doesn't have to get up. I've pinned a sign-up list with the 10 dates, 5 to 16 October: put your name against one by Thursday 1 October. I'll post the final rota on Friday and cover any gaps myself. Please don't knock or ring for now; I'll post in here when Ruth is up for visitors.
note: One concrete plan, a one-slot action, a deadline and a default, plus the one rule that protects the person being helped. If anyone is worried about Ruth, call her daughter, and in an emergency call emergency services rather than posting in the group.

situation: I organised a birthday dinner for Mia this Saturday, table for 8 at Nonna's at 7:30, booked under my name with a £10 deposit each already paid. My shift just got changed and I can't go. Lena said privately she's happy to be the contact for the restaurant.
reply: Bad news from me: my shift has moved and I can't make Saturday, sorry all. Don't change a thing. The table at Nonna's is still booked for 8 at 7:30, and I've told them Lena is the contact now, so any changes go to her. My deposit stays in, so nobody's out of pocket. Have the best night, Mia, I'll take you for a birthday drink next week.
note: Dropping out of a plan you organised: hand the logistics to a named person you've already asked, and change nothing for everyone else.

situation: I book a 5-a-side pitch every Wednesday at 7pm for £60, split between whoever plays. I spend every Tuesday chasing people and some weeks we end up 4 v 4. The centre lets me cancel for free up to 24 hours before.
reply: Wednesday football, new system so I stop chasing everyone: 👍 this message by 6pm Tuesday if you're playing. If we've got 8 or more by then, the pitch stays booked and it's £6 each for 10, £7.50 for 8. If we're under 8, I cancel before the free cutoff and we go again the week after. No need to reply if you're out. Starting with Wednesday 7 October.
note: A threshold is still a default: say the number that keeps it on, what happens below it, and let silence mean out when a no-show costs money.

situation: 小学校のPTAのLINEグループ（保護者22人）で、10月24日（土）のバザーの受付係を4人集めたい。「どなたかお願いします」と2回投稿したけど、誰も手を挙げない。受付は9時〜13時で、名簿にチェックするだけの係。
reply:
バザー受付のお願いです。10月24日（土）、受付を2枠×2人でお願いしたいです。
①9:00〜11:00
②11:00〜13:00
できる方は①か②をこのメッセージに返信してください。10月7日（水）の夜までに埋まらなかった枠は、まだ係に入っていない方に私から個別にお声がけします。2時間だけで、名簿にチェックするだけの係です。
note: 「どなたか」は誰も動かないので、枠と時間を小さく切り、締切と締切後の段取りを先に書く。

situation: 我在大学同学群（52人）里组织毕业十周年聚会，定在11月7日。群里每天几百条红包和表情包，聚会的通知发出去几分钟就被刷没了，好几个人说根本没看到。
reply: 提个建议：聚会的事单独建一个“十周年聚会通知群”，只发时间、地点和费用，不闲聊，这个大群照常热闹。想参加或者想看安排的，在这条消息下面回个“1”就行，今晚10点前我统一拉进去。错过的同学之后随时私聊我，我再拉你进去。
note: 群太吵、信息被刷掉时，提议分出一个只发通知的小群，用一键回复加截止时间把人拉进去。

situation: 我们六家约了10月11日周日中午在公园野餐，每家带点吃的。结果丽丽、老周、阿杰、小敏四家都说带水果，王姐家带饮料，没人带主食，也没人带餐垫和餐具。我想在群里把分工定下来。
reply: 大家好，现在四家都报了水果，主食和餐具还没人带，我来排一下，大家看行不行：丽丽家带水果，王姐家带饮料，老周家和阿杰家带主食（饭团、三明治都行），小敏家带点心，我家带餐垫、一次性餐具和垃圾袋。同意的扣个1，想换的直接说。周四晚上9点前没人提意见就按这个来，我再发一版最终分工。
note: 直接给出分工方案而不是问谁带什么，一键回复，加上截止时间和默认安排。

situation: I'm hosting a birthday barbecue for 12 friends in Lark Park this Saturday Oct 3 at 1pm. The forecast now says heavy rain all Saturday and dry on Sunday, and people keep posting weather screenshots asking 'is it still on?'. My flat fits 12 but I can't use the grill there.
reply: Settling the weather question: Saturday looks like a washout, so two options. A: same barbecue, moved to Sunday 4 October, 1pm, Lark Park. B: keep Saturday 3 October, 1pm, at my flat, with oven food instead of the grill. Vote A or B by Thursday 9pm. If it's a tie or nobody votes, it's A, and I'll post the final plan once on Thursday night.
note: A change of plan still needs a decision: turn 'is it still on?' into two concrete options with a deadline and a default instead of watching the forecast together.

situation: Five of us are on the last night of our Lisbon trip and have spent an hour in the WhatsApp group going back and forth about dinner. Ana found Casa Lena, a seafood place 10 minutes from the flat, which can take 5 of us at 8:30 if I confirm by 7. Sam wanted pizza.
reply: Okay, executive decision so we actually eat: Casa Lena, seafood, 10 minutes from the flat, 8:30, table for 5. I'm confirming at 7 unless someone has a real dealbreaker, like an allergy or the budget, before then. Sam, pizza gets first pick for the next trip.
note: When the group is going in circles in real time, decide, give a short window for genuine dealbreakers only, and hand the next pick to whoever lost this one. Anyone with a serious allergy tells the restaurant when ordering, and if someone reacts, call 112 straight away.

situation: Ich organisiere unser Klassentreffen (20 Jahre Abitur) am Samstag, 14. November, im Gasthaus Linde. In der WhatsApp-Umfrage stehen 18 Zusagen und 9 „vielleicht“. Das Gasthaus braucht bis Freitag, 6. November, die genaue Personenzahl.
reply: Kurzer Stand zum Klassentreffen am Samstag, 14. November, im Gasthaus Linde: 18 Zusagen, 9 Vielleicht. Die Linde braucht am Freitag, 6. November, die genaue Zahl. Bitte macht aus eurem Vielleicht bis Mittwoch, 4. November, 20 Uhr ein Ja oder Nein, Daumen hoch oder runter reicht. Wer dann noch auf Vielleicht steht, zähle ich als Nein. Wer danach doch kommen will, schreibt mir privat, und ich frage in der Linde nach einem Platz.
note: Ein Vielleicht hilft beim Planen nicht: Frist vor der echten Frist setzen und sagen, dass ein offenes Vielleicht als Nein zählt.

situation: Our D&D group of five plays on Discord. Priya's work shifts changed, so I posted a poll for a new session day: Tuesday 7:30pm or Sunday 3pm. Four days later it's 2 for Tuesday and 1 for Sunday, and Marcus and Priya haven't voted.
reply: @Marcus @Priya you're the last two votes on the new session day: Tuesday 7:30pm or Sunday 3pm. Priya, it's your shifts we're working around, so if one of these doesn't work for you, just say and that settles it. React T or S by Thursday night. If we don't hear, it's Tuesday, starting Tuesday 6 October.
note: Name the two missing voters warmly, give the person the change is for a quiet veto, and keep the deadline and default.

situation: 我妈10月12日周一做膝关节置换手术，预计10月16日周五出院，医生说出院后头两周白天需要有人在家陪着。我们兄妹三个在家庭群里说了好几天“到时候再看”，一直没定。我哥周末有空，妹妹工作日下午能请假，我工作日上午可以在家办公，出院那天我也能去接。
reply: 哥、妹，妈出院后的陪护咱们今天定下来吧。我提个方案：10月16日周五出院那天我去接；之后两周，工作日上午我在家办公陪着，下午妹妹请假过去接班，周六周日哥哥全天。同意的回个1，想换的直接说换哪天。今晚10点前没人提意见就按这个来，我再做个表发群里。
note: 家里人之间也一样：给出完整方案和默认做法，比问“谁有空”快得多。出院时问清医生护理要点，陪护期间如果妈妈发烧、伤口红肿或摔倒，马上联系医院，紧急情况直接打120。

situation: My grandparents' 50th wedding anniversary is Saturday 21 November. They're both in the big family WhatsApp group, so I've started a separate group with the 9 aunts, uncles and cousins to plan a surprise lunch. Aunt Rosa has offered her house; I'm thinking 1pm, everyone brings a dish.
reply: Welcome to the secret group! Nothing about this in the main family chat, since Nana and Grandad are in it. Proposal: surprise lunch for their 50th on Saturday 21 November, 1pm at Aunt Rosa's, everyone brings a dish. 👍 if you're in, 👎 if you can't make it, by Sunday 11 October please. If I hear nothing I'll count you in, and we'll sort who brings what after that.
note: Secrecy is the reason for the smaller thread; say it once, then run the usual proposal, deadline and default.

situation: 大学宿舍六个人的群，想约10月17日周六晚上6点半一起吃饭。室友小敏去年出车祸后坐轮椅，我私下问过她，她说只要有电梯和无障碍卫生间就行，但不想在群里被特别提。我找了两家都符合条件的：望江楼是江景包间，小院子是川菜、离地铁近。
reply: 姐妹们，10月17日周六晚上6点半聚一下吧！两个选项：A 望江楼，江景包间；B 小院子，川菜，离地铁近。回A或B就行，10月7日周三晚上10点前统计，按多数定，平票就选A。订好后我在群里发一次地址。
note: 照顾某个人的需求不必在群里点名：私下确认条件，只把都符合条件的选项放进投票。

situation: 我组织部门8个人10月16日周五晚上聚餐。上次聚餐酒水占了一大半费用，不喝酒的三个人（小周、阿琳和我）也一起AA了，阿琳私下跟我说有点亏。这次想在群里提前把规矩定好：饭菜大家平摊，酒水由喝酒的人平摊。
reply: 各位，10月16日周五晚上的聚餐，先把分钱方式定一下：饭菜大家平摊，酒水由喝酒的同事平摊，当天我结完账会把单子拆成两部分发到群里。同意的回个1，有别的想法10月6日周二下班前说，没人提意见就按这个来。
note: 分账规则要在吃饭前定，事后再提就成了算账吵架；只给规则，不点名是谁提的。有人喝酒的话，散场前确认大家怎么回家，喝了酒不开车，有人明显喝多了要有人陪着送回去。

situation: 我组织的读书会群有11个人，每月一次。这个月原定10月18日周日下午2点在半页书店，截止昨晚只有2人报名，书店要求至少5人才留座。想取消这次，下次在11月8日和11月15日两个周日下午2点里选一个，还是半页书店。
reply: 跟大家说一下：10月18日周日下午的读书会这次取消。截止昨晚报名的是2位，半页书店要至少5人才留座，报了名的两位抱歉啦。下次在这两个时间里选一个：A 11月8日周日下午2点，B 11月15日周日下午2点，地点还是半页书店。回A或B就行，10月25日周日晚上10点前统计，按多数定，平票就选A。
note: 取消也要发得干脆：原因说一次，不抱怨没人报名，直接给下次的两个选项、截止时间和默认规则。

situation: I'm organising Secret Santa in our friend group chat of 10. I want a £20 limit, names drawn on Sunday 15 November, and gifts swapped at our Christmas dinner on Saturday 12 December. Last year two people were put in without being asked and one of them forgot to buy a gift.
reply: Secret Santa time! Proposal: £20 limit, names drawn on Sunday 15 November, gifts swapped at Christmas dinner on Saturday 12 December. This year it's opt-in: 👍 this message by Friday 13 November if you want to be in the draw. No reply means you're not in it, and that's completely fine; you're still very much invited to dinner.
note: When joining costs people money, let silence mean out, never in; that also fixes last year's forgotten gift.

situation: Our old uni band, four of us (Jess, Arun, Mo and me), has a WhatsApp group that's been silent since March. I want to get a jam going: Studio 9 has a room free on Saturday 24 October, 2 to 5pm, for £60, so £15 each, and it has to be booked by Wednesday 14 October.
reply: Reviving this chat with an actual plan: jam at Studio 9, Saturday 24 October, 2 to 5pm, £15 each. 👍 by Tuesday 13 October if you're in, and I'll book it on Wednesday. If three of us are in, it's on at £20 each; if not, I'll suggest another date rather than chase anyone. No reply means you're sitting this one out, no hard feelings.
note: A dormant chat comes back with a concrete plan, not 'we should catch up'; when it costs money, silence means out.

situation: 我是一个徒步群的领队，群里12个人约了10月10日周六去爬山，早上7点在地铁站集合，每人交了50元包车费。今天的天气预报说周六下午有雷阵雨，山顶那段没地方躲。周日11日预报是晴天，司机说周日也能出车。
reply: 各位，周六下午预报有雷阵雨，山顶那段没地方躲，安全第一，这次就不投票了：改到10月11日周日，还是早上7点地铁站集合，司机周日能出车。周日能来的扣个1，来不了的私信我，50元包车费全退。10月8日周四晚上9点统计人数，到时没回复的我就当周日不来，费用照退。
note: 涉及安全时由组织者拍板，不拿来投票；只给一个方案、一键回复和截止时间。出发当天天气变坏照样取消，遇险立即拨打当地报警或急救电话。

situation: My manager asked me to pick the date for our team volunteering day in our team Slack channel; there are 7 of us. Hillgate Community Pantry can take us on Wednesday 21 October or Thursday 29 October, 9am to 1pm, and I have to tell them by Friday 9 October. It's optional, and I don't want anyone to feel pushed into it.
reply: Volunteering day: Hillgate Community Pantry can host us on Wednesday 21 October or Thursday 29 October, 9am to 1pm. React with 1️⃣ or 2️⃣ by Wednesday 7 October at 5pm and I'll confirm whichever gets more votes with them on Thursday; if it's a tie, it's the 21st. It's optional, so if neither date works or you'd rather sit this one out, no need to explain.
note: At work, keep the two options, deadline and tie-break, but make opting out as easy as voting so nobody reads it as a requirement.

situation: Le père de notre collègue Hélène est décédé mardi. Dans le groupe WhatsApp de l'équipe, dont Hélène ne fait pas partie, je veux proposer d'envoyer une gerbe pour les obsèques, jeudi 8 octobre, et une carte signée par tous. Le fleuriste veut la commande avant mardi 6 octobre midi ; la gerbe coûte 90 euros, soit 10 euros chacun si nous participons tous les neuf.
reply: Bonjour à tous, comme vous le savez peut-être, le père d'Hélène est décédé mardi. Je propose qu'on envoie une gerbe pour les obsèques jeudi 8 octobre, 90 euros, soit 10 euros chacun si on participe tous, et une carte que je ferai circuler au bureau pour que chacun la signe. Un 👍 d'ici lundi soir si vous participez : je commande mardi matin et je partage le montant entre ceux qui auront répondu. Si vous préférez ne pas participer, aucun souci, dites-le-moi en privé.
note: Sujet délicat : une proposition complète, un délai, et le silence ne compte pas comme un oui.
